section.title: Deep-Tail Fade Signals
section.text:
Generated by omega.generate from the 'Deep-Tail Fade' thesis (stance FADE, anchor 1h). pctB: where the close sits in the Bollinger envelope, (close − lower) / (upper − lower) — 0 at the lower band, 1 at the upper, outside [0,1] when price trades beyond them. 4-period trajectory (t3 → … → now); closed bars only (the forming bar is excluded); pctB_trend = direction over the window. bbWidthPct: Bollinger band spread as a % of its own middle band, ((upper − lower) / middle) × 100 — the cross-coin comparable form of BBwidth. BBtouch: price contact with a Bollinger band (upper / lower / none). RSI14: 14-period relative strength index (0–100). 4-period trajectory (t3 → … → now); closed bars only (the forming bar is excluded); RSI14_trend = direction over the window. RSI14_zone: thresholded regime (overbought / oversold / neutral). MFI14: 14-period money flow index (volume-weighted RSI, 0–100). 4-period trajectory (t3 → … → now); closed bars only (the forming bar is excluded); MFI14_trend = direction over the window. MFI14_zone: thresholded regime (overbought / oversold / neutral). CVD: cumulative volume delta accumulated since the daily 00:00-UTC anchor. 4-period trajectory (t3 → … → now); closed bars only (the forming bar is excluded); CVD_trend = direction over the window. buyPres: buy share of traded volume (0–1). 3-period trajectory (t2 → … → now); closed bars only (the forming bar is excluded); buyPres_trend = direction over the window.

marketReadPreview.gridText:
Deep-Tail Fade. 1h contrarian reversion on majors. Research-derived (2026-08-29, 13-coin candle study): stretch reversion at 1h concentrates in the deep tail (>90th pct stretch: 61.5% hit, +13 bps/bar) and is strongest on majors; volume-weighted references added nothing over plain means, so the native Bollinger machinery carries the thesis. Wins are small and losses are big when stretches continue - selectivity is the whole game.

- DF_UP (UP) - Setup confirmed - up.
- DF_DOWN (DOWN) - Setup confirmed - down.

Read these verdicts rather than re-deriving them from the columns.

Conditions are deterministic reads of your report columns, resolved server-side at prompt-build time. They are advisory: they may make you more selective, never less — they do not gate, score, or qualify anything. TRUE / FALSE / UNRESOLVED are three distinct states; UNRESOLVED means an input was missing, not that the read was false. A value marked (provisional) came from the live forming bar and can still change before that bar closes.

reviewContext.confirmationSummary: CREATE strategy 'Deep-Tail Fade' as revision 1; changed axes: IDENTITY, TIMEFRAME_PROFILE, REPORT, MARKET_READ, CONDITIONS, SETUP_GATES, SIGNAL_RULES, LIFECYCLE; 0 bound agent(s) and 0 open position(s) observed.

_interpretation: Two refusals, two NEW platform facts, nothing compiled viable yet. (1) The runtime input validator now REQUIRES sections[].notes, conditions[].clock (LIVE|CLOSE) and conditions[].closes - none in the published schema; the connector deployed a condition-clock feature after the 2026-08-29 update loop (which compiled with neither field). (2) CONDITION_CLOCK_OPERAND_ILLEGAL: CLOSE-clocked conditions may only read the coin's own candle-series headers at offset 0; ambient headers (reference-pairs, session-field) must sit in LIVE-clocked conditions, referenced from LIVE conditions. Fix mapped but NOT submitted: RISK_ON/CTX_UP/CTX_DOWN and the composite UP/DOWN verdicts -> LIVE; candle-only CORE_UP/CORE_DOWN stay CLOSE. Stopped per the session authorization (one compile call spent); a further compile needs fresh per-instance authorization. omega gap opened: wire() emits none of the three new fields - code update + tests required once semantics are confirmed viable. READ-BACK ADDENDUM: platform migrated existing conditions to clock=LIVE/closes=1 (LIVE permissive, CLOSE restricted); sections.notes migrated null; a NEW unmeasured 'entry' axis {trigger, confirmTf, closes, bandAtrMultiple} exists in the persisted shape but not the compile schema. Migration plan: docs/superpowers/plans/2026-08-29-condition-clock-migration.md.
